rationale: A 7.4% gap on 31.7x relative volume has consolidated in a tight ~0.8% range all session while holding above VWAP ($31.82) with no evidence of distribution — sellers have had nearly three hours to fade the gap and the low sits only 0.4% below the open, which mechanically favors upside resolution of the compression.
